subject.title: [Feature]: Bundled RCS channel (Twilio) as a sibling to the sms channel

question: Does RCS’s distinct rich-message, branded-identity, and receipt capability justify a bundled exception to OpenClaw’s plugin-first policy, or should the linked implementation ship through ClawHub?
rationale: The repository provides a strong plugin-first default and current SDK/package seams appear adequate, but the claimed carrier auto-upgrade and shared SMS/RCS operational model create a plausible exception that only maintainers can choose to own long term.

options.title: Publish as plugin
options.body: Keep core lean and publish the RCS channel from its own repository through ClawHub using the existing channel-plugin SDK, removing or generalizing bundled-only SMS forwarding.

options.title: Sponsor bundling
options.body: Accept long-term core ownership of RCS configuration, dependencies, webhook security, delivery semantics, documentation, and upgrade behavior, then continue technical review of the linked PR.

recommendation.title: Publish as plugin
recommendation.body: Keep core lean and publish the RCS channel from its own repository through ClawHub using the existing channel-plugin SDK, removing or generalizing bundled-only SMS forwarding.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the SMS channel and most recently maintained its plugin distribution shape, so he is the strongest available owner for deciding whether RCS belongs at the same ownership tier.
